text: Fijne app, duidelijk en makkelijk te gebruiken, maar erg hinderlijk dat je taken niet terugkerend kan maken. Sport, werken, etc. Zal fijner geweest zijn met kleine advertenties in de onder/boven balken, of wanneer je het opend je een snelle advertentie krijgt in plaats van redelijk veel geld moeten uitgeven ervoor
author: Ming Qi Huang
developer_reply: Thank you for your review. Structured is a handmade app, without a big company behind it. We want to make Structured accessible for everyone, which is why the app can be used for free without any ads or user data being sold. The Structured Pro subscriptions enable us to maintain and develop Structured. We appreciate your understanding.

text: Love the app, really gave me an insight in my lack of time management due to my AuDHD. If the AI function of iOS would come to Android and the full custom colour option would be available for the app background as well it would be 5 stars! Especially importing my google calendar and automatically updating the rest of the day when adjusting a time is what I'm looking for! It's really unpractical to update the schedule when you have to squeeze something in your daily planning.
author: Ylva Lambregts
developer_reply:
Thank you for your review and your honest feedback. We have an update for you: The Google Calendar import is available now on Android. Learn more about this in our Help Center: strct.app/calendar
Moreover, the Structured AI, which helps you to quickly reschedule events and tasks, has been available for a while now.

text: I personally bought the app to BE more structured and although it's affordable, the basics are wrong. 1/ top part doesn't show actual dates which makes it confusing 2/ the app "completes" tasks based on time scheduled. Not because they have been actually completed by ME. 3/ if you do not open the app for X amount of days, it simply stops given you notifications. So no, not really the added structure I was looking for. I reverted back to my calendar to add reminders and timers.
